notes: Restoryboard for the rewrite, against script.md as rewritten on 2026-10-10/11 and take6@1.08.words.json, which narration.json names. The narration no longer says '줄' or '불이 켜진다': B4 states the rule ('다 0과 1로만 이루어진 수를 찾아요') and later beats say 'N진법까지' (bases 2 through N). So the lamps are gone everywhere (counter, funnel, search bar) and a yellow ✓ beside each form made only of 0s and 1s replaces them. Kept from the first pass: every element id but 'range' (dropped, see the funnel note), the color meanings, fix round 1's Sequence layout (no dotted gap), and the counter's row positions.

Geometry is px in the 1080×1920 frame, origin top-left; points are [x, y]. The content bounds are x 140–940 and the visual zone y 240–1250; every white or saturated edge stays at least 8 px inside them (x 148–932), since 005 found a white edge rings about 8 px in the encode: the full-width outlines are drawn on x 150 and 930, so their 4 px strokes end at 148 and 932.

One sequence, two layouts (Sequence 'seq'), unchanged from fix round 1. The five cells sit side by side with the ordinary gap, so they read as one sequence (the human's first-look note: no dotted jump between 4 and 82000, at frame 0, in the header and at the loop). Big, for frame 0 and the loop (B1, B11's end): terms in TeX 87 (digits 70 px tall), cells 104 × 140 (82000's 316 wide), 12 apart, centered on y 745 (y 675–815): 2 at x 150–254, 3 at 266–370, 4 at 382–486, 82000 at 498–814 (its ink about 254 px wide), the dashed ? cell at 826–930. Header, from B2's '몰라요' to B11's first word: the same row scaled 0.55 about its center and moved to center [540, 300]: x 325–755, y 261–339, TeX 48 (digits 38.6 px tall), strokes and dashes unscaled. A header cell is filled (yellow outline, yellow fill at 0.15: the action is still called 'light') when its number has just come out as the answer: 2 in B4, 3 and 4 in B5, 82000 in B7.

The counter (BaseCounter 'counter'), B3–B8. The number itself ('10진법' row: no box, no mark, digits always white): its name's ink from x 180 (Pretendard SemiBold 48, 129 px wide), digits TeX 64 (51.6 px tall) right-aligned in columns of 38.72 px (one digit's advance) with the ones column centered at x 816 (82000's ink x 645–832), ink center y 452. Base rows: each a box x 150–930, 100 tall (y ± 50), corners 16, a muted 4 px outline that never changes color; its name ('{base}진법') with ink from x 180 (about 105 px wide: x 180–285); its digits TeX 48 (38.7 px tall) right-aligned in columns of 29.04 px with the ones column centered at x 816, right under the decimal row's; its ✓ slot centered at x 878. With the lamps gone the names move left from x 250 to 180 and the ones column from 886 to 816, which makes room for the ✓ at the digits' right: 82000's 17 binary digits run from x 341 to 828, 56 px clear of '2진법'; a ✓'s ink is x 855–902, 27 px right of the ones digit's ink and 26 px inside the outline. Row centers: 3진법 at 584 in B3; from B4 2진법 584, 3진법 712, 4진법 840, 5진법 968; B8 adds 6진법 at 1096 (box to y 1146).

The pass mark, which replaces the lamp. It is a yellow ✓ in a fixed column just right of each row's ones digit, so the verdict sits next to the digits that decide it. A row has its ✓ exactly when every digit in it is 0 or 1. From B4's '영과' every digit 2 or more is red, and one red digit means the row has no ✓. The ✓ is the only mark, as script B4 asks: a failing row gets no ✗, and no box or band lights. Marks go live on B4's '일로만' ('marks'). From then on they follow the digits on every frame, so no ✓ is ever placed by hand. The 2진법 row has its ✓ from '일로만' to the counter's exit, since every number is 0/1 in base 2 (C2). The number the episode looks for is the one whose rows all carry a ✓.

Why B4 reads (QA r1#1 and the cut critique both asked for a visible reason). On '영과' the three 2s turn red. On '일로만' the ✓ draws in beside 2진법's '10', and only there. On '이루어진' the three red 2s blink twice: their opacity dips while they stay full red. Each of them sits 62 px left of its own row's empty ✓ slot. On '찾아요' the header's 2 fills. The reason (a red digit) and the verdict (a ✓ or none) share each row's right end. The first pass's lamp sat 650 px away from the digits, which is why its blink went unnoticed.

The run (B6) and the near misses. B6 is now the one word '오진법까지는요?' (0.78 s). Over it the value climbs from 5 to 81,899 on a log scale with smooth easing, one value per frame, digits changing in place. Rows 3–5 mostly have no ✓, but one flickers on now and then on a real number that passes (runValues' flicker, as in the first render). The value then stops at the five near misses in B6's pause, about 0.24 s each: 81900, 81901, 81921, 81984 and 81985 ('count', slow over 1.2 s). 81985 holds for the rest of the pause, about 0.3 s, before 82000 on B7's '팔만'. B7 no longer opens with '네 줄은', so all five near misses now sit in B6's pause. In the first pass two of them came in B7. Rendered: each near miss shows for 7 frames (81921 for 8, 81985 for 17 with its hold), its ✓s settled from its second frame. The count passes one number on the way to 81921 (81911, f716) and to 82000 (81993, f748), a frame each, where the ✓s follow those digits; at 82000 the 3진법 and 4진법 ✓s stay whole and only 5진법's draws in.

Funnel (B9): counted values from verify.py (C13), drawn as four stepped tiers 780, 676, 572 and 468 wide, not to scale (to scale, 30 and 1 would be invisible: the script's note). Tier 1 is named '2부터 10만까지' with 99,999, the script's '2부터 10만까지 99,999개(2진법은 모두 통과)'. Tiers 2–4 are '3진법까지', '4진법까지' and '5진법까지', the narration's wording. This drops the first pass's heading Note 'range' and its tier name '2진법 줄까지'. That name read as if base 2 had filtered something (cut critique, Claude #2). Now the range itself is the first tier, and it drops in on '이부터 십만까지'. The tiers carry no lamps. The funnel moves 40 px down into the heading's old place.

Search bar (B10): the axis is digit count, not size. The left end is 82000's dot, a plain yellow dot now (no lamp), labeled '82000' above and '5자리' below. The right tick is labeled '10진법 1100만 자리' below, and '자릿수' names the bar above it. Past the tick the bar goes on as a dashed line fading out by x 924: the search stopped there, the numbers didn't (C7–C8). The searched part turns white as the scan light passes, and no other dot appears. The narration now says the search was for bases 2–5 ('오진법까지 되는 수조차', C6–C8), which answers the cut critique's worry that B10 followed B8's base 6.

Frame 0 is the hook, unchanged: seq in the big layout, visibleAtStart, all five cells white and unfilled, under the caption '2, 3, 4, 82000, 그다음은?'. The row spans the full content width at the middle of the zone; the caption's math is 47.5 px tall against the cells' 70 px, so the two don't read as the same line twice at one size.

Loop: B11 moves seq back to the big layout, unfills its cells and returns 2, 3, 4, 82000 to full opacity on its first word, with the bar's exits; the last ? blink ends before the 0.5 s pause does, so the last frame is frame 0's picture.

Easing: theme.ts's ease.out for appear and reveal, ease.exit for exit, ease.smooth otherwise, unless params say linear. A beat's first-word cue that isn't an entrance or exit is linear (B1's, B2's dimming, B4's set, B5's step, B8's blink), so it shows inside the 3-frame reaction window. Cues sharing an anchor run in parallel; an appear or reveal waits for that anchor's exits (B9, B10).

Draw order is declaration order: seq < counter < funnel < axisName < scan < startLabel < endLabel. No two of them share space while both are visible; the header stays above y 339 and everything else below y 373.

Text in the visual zone: TeX numbers (sizes above), the counter's row names and the funnel's tier names in Pretendard SemiBold 48 (a '2' is 34 px tall, the smallest glyph), and three Notes (type.label 56): '자릿수' 143 px, '5자리' 122, '10진법 1100만 자리' 445. TeX measured with measure-tex.mts (digits at 48: '0' 24.4 × 40, '1' 20 × 38.7; at 64: '99{,}999' 208, '2{,}046' 169, '30' 71, '1' 27 px wide); Pretendard widths from the static OTFs (fontTools). Captions measured the same way at 60 px: the widest are '2진법부터 5진법까지 써 봐요.' 697 px and '1100만 자리까지 찾아봤지만,' 692 px, both on one line.

Extents worked out, then checked in the render's decoded frames: a ✓ x 855–902 at rest (measured 855–901), 850–907 at its 1.25× pulse (measured; its strokes keep their 6 px, so not the 849 first worked out), 22 px from the ones digit's ink (x 828) and 21 px inside the outline; the dot measured x 214–247 at rest and 209–251 at its pulse; row names x 180–285 ('10진법' 180–309); the funnel's names start 32 px in (tier 1 '2부터 10만까지' x 182–475, its 99,999 x 690–898; tier 4 '5진법까지' 338–526, its 1 x 715–742); the bar's labels as in the first render ('82000' x 157–303, '5자리' 169–291, '10진법 1100만 자리' 478–922, '자릿수' 469–611); the dot x 214–246, 209–251 at its 1.3× pulse. Ink spans at beat ends: B1 and B11 x 148–932 (the cells' strokes); B2 323–757; B3–B8 148–932 (the boxes); B9 148–932; B10 157–922. Every beat end is symmetric about x 540 by construction (boxes, tiers and cells centered; the bar's labels as in the first render, which measured within 2 px).

Pacing. B2 and B8 have pauseAfter 0 instead of the script's 0.3 s. take6 has a breath at about −43 dB in both gaps and no 0.15 s silence, so build-cues.py can't insert a pause there. The take's own gaps after them, 0.58 s and 0.56 s, remain. For the same reason B2's move into the header starts on '몰라요' and not in a pause: B2's pause anchor would fall on B3's first word. B4 gets 0.4 s the script didn't have, so the first ✓ and the blinking red 2s stay still for about 0.9 s before B5. B6's 1.0 s pause carries the near misses and B7's 1.0 s pause the held result, both as the script asks. Estimated length 46.0 s: speech ends at 42.13 s of the take, minus 0.12 s of leading trim, plus 4.0 s of pauses.

components.name: Sequence
components.spec: A sequence's terms side by side in a row of cells (the 2, 3, 4, 82000, ? header). Props: terms (TeX strings in order; cells are addressed by their term), open (the term whose cell is drawn dashed: '?'), center [x, y], size (TeX px), cell [w, h] (a one-digit cell), wide (the width of a longer term's cell), gap (between cells). Drawing: each cell a rounded rect (corners 12) outlined 4 px (stroke.line) in text, no fill, its term's ink centered in it, TeX in text; the open cell's outline dashed (stroke.dash). A filled ('lit') cell: outline yellow and fill yellow at 0.15 (hotel.lit), its term still text, at full opacity whatever setStyle set. Actions: moveTo {center, scale} (the whole row moves and scales about its center, TeX size with it; strokes and dashes keep their px); setStyle {cells, opacity}; light {cells} (outline and fill fade to filled over the span); unlight {cells: all | [..]}; pulse {cells} (each cell's outline thickens 4 → 8 px inward and its term grows up to 1.15×, staying 6 px clear of the outline, and back; the cell itself doesn't grow, so neighbors never touch); blink {cells, times} (the cell's opacity dips to 0.25 and back `times` times over the span, ending at rest).

components.name: BaseCounter
components.status: existing, rework: a ✓ pass mark replaces the lamps
components.spec: One number, and the same number written in several bases, row under row; each base row shows a ✓ when it has only 0s and 1s. Props: value (start), decimal {y, label, labelX, size, ones} (the number in base 10: its name's ink from labelX, its digits right-aligned on the ones column; no box, no mark, digits always text), rowStyle {box: [x0, x1], height, radius, labelX, label ('{base}' stands for the row's base), size, ones, markX} (shared by the base rows). Base rows exist once added (addRow); each draws a rounded box (muted 4 px outline, which never changes color and has no fill), its name 'N진법' (Pretendard SemiBold 48, text) with ink from labelX, the value's digits in base N right-aligned in one-digit columns (TeX size, column pitch one digit's advance, so equal digits stack as the number grows leftward), and, once marks are live, its ✓ centered at (markX, row y) while the row qualifies. Digits are text; after `color`, a digit of 2 or more is red (the decimal row stays text). The ✓: a check of two strokes in yellow, 6 px (stroke.sheet), round caps and join, through (−20, 1), (−7, 15) and (21, −15) from its center (ink about 47 × 36 px, a digit's height). Before `marks` no row has one; after it, a row has its ✓ exactly when its digits are all 0 or 1. A ✓ that comes draws itself along its path (short stroke, then long) over duration.fast; one that goes fades over duration.fast; during a step it follows the new digits from the roll's halfway, as the lamps did; during `run` it follows the value within the frame, fully drawn, so a one-frame flicker shows whole; during `count` each stop is weighed against the stop before it: on the numbers counted through between stops the ✓s follow the digits within the frame, as in a run, and at a stop a ✓ both stops have stays whole, one new at this stop draws over at most counter.markCount (0.4) of the stop's slot (duration.fast at the last stop), and one lost goes at once (the digits passed on the way already took it). Actions: appear (the decimal row fades in); addRow {base, y} (that row's box, name and digits fade in at y, in the counter's colors, and its ✓ with them if marks are live and it qualifies); moveRow {base, y} (slides); color (digits of 2 or more turn red over the span); marks (✓s go live over the span: the rows that qualify draw theirs); step {to} (the value changes to `to`: in every row each digit column that changes rolls upward, the old digit rising 20 px and fading out as the new one rises 20 px into place, a new leading column rising in at the left, a vanished one fading; rolls stay inside their row's box); set {to} (a crossfade, no roll: resets); run {from, to} (with until: the value climbs on a log scale under ease.smooth, one value per frame, digits changing in place; every third frame the first number at or above the schedule's value that passes exactly one of rows 3+ if there is one before the next frame's value, so a ✓ flickers on a real number); count {stops} (each stop gets an equal slot of the span: the value counts up through the numbers between in the slot's first quarter, a number per frame, skipping evenly if there are more numbers than frames, then holds the stop); pulse {part: marks, rows?} (each named row's ✓ scales 1.25 about its center and back; a row without one shows nothing) or {part: digits, rows?, which: red | all, color?} (those digits scale up to 1.15 about their centers, stopping 3 px short of a neighbor, turning to `color` at the peak if given, and back); blink {rows?, which: red | all, times?} (those digits' opacity dips to 0.25 and back `times` times over the span, keeping their color); exit. Dropped from the first pass: lamps, power, pulse {part: lamps}, the lit outline and band; lamp.tsx and theme.ts's lamp tokens (counter.rays, rayCount, rayTurn, rayWidth, lampPulse, band, tierLamp, tierLampX, scanLamp) are then unused.

components.name: Funnel
components.spec: A stepped funnel of counts: centered tiers narrowing downward, one per filter, and what comes out at the bottom. Props: x (center), height (each tier's), tiers [{y, w, label, count}] (y the tier's center, label Pretendard SemiBold 48, count TeX), output {tex, y, cell: [w, h]}. Drawing: a tier is a rounded rect (corners 16), muted 4 px outline, no fill; inside it, its label with ink from 32 px in (text; the first pass's lamp and its 84 px indent are gone, so the label mirrors the count's margin), and its count (TeX 64, text) with the ink's right edge 32 px in from its right edge, vertically centered on the digits' ink. Output: an arrow (5 px, muted, head 18) from 8 px under the last tier's bottom straight down 32 px, onto a filled cell (Sequence's filled style, corners 12) holding the output TeX (56, text). Actions: appear (tier 1 drops in: fades in while sliding 40 px down into place); reveal {tier: n} (tier n drops in the same way); reveal {part: output} (the arrow grows down, then the cell fades in filled); exit.

components.name: ScanBar
components.status: existing, rework: a plain dot for the lamp
components.spec: A searched range: a bar from a found point to how far the search went, a dashed continuation past it, and a light that sweeps it. Props: from [x, y] (the left end), to [x, y] (the searched end), tail (the x where the continuation has faded out), dot {label, labelY} (the found point at `from` and its TeX label). Drawing: the bar a 6 px (stroke.sheet) line from `from` to `to`, muted where the scan has not passed and text where it has; a tick at `to`, 4 px, text, 44 px tall centered on the bar; past it a dashed 6 px line (stroke.dash) to `tail`, each dash at the opacity of its x, 1 at `to` falling linearly to 0 at `tail` (fade.ts); the dot a filled yellow disc r 16 on `from` (no rays: it was BaseCounter's lit lamp), its label TeX 50 in yellow, ink centered at (from.x, labelY). Actions: appear (the bar draws left to right from the dot, the tick and the dashes last); scan (with until: a light, a 14 px yellow disc trailing a 90 px yellow line that fades behind it, runs from the dot to the tick at constant speed, the bar turning text behind it, and fades out on the tick; no other dot appears); pulse {part: dot} (the dot scales 1.3 and back); exit.

components.name: Note
components.spec: One line of plain text with $...$ math (studio/src/components/Note.tsx): props text, at [x, y] (the ink center), color (default text); type.label. Actions: appear, exit, setText. Used for the search bar's '자릿수', '5자리' and '10진법 1100만 자리' (B10).
